'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sokol LS Restore Freedom''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Light.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
